# 3D Extension Design Notes

This section contains design notes for extending Subsetix Kokkos to 3D domains.

## Overview

The current implementation focuses on 2D sparse domains using CSR interval sets. Extension to 3D requires careful consideration of:

- Data structure design for 3D sparse domains
- Efficient set algebra operations in 3D
- GPU-compatible parallel kernels

## Key Design Challenges

### Memory Layout

3D sparse domains require efficient representation of:
- Z-coordinate intervals per row
- Y-coordinate rows per z-level
- Cell indexing and offsets

### Set Algebra Operations

Union, intersection, and difference operations must be extended to 3D:
- Sweep-based algorithms
- Efficient interval merging/splitting
- Parallel kernel design
